context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 240 fully tested. Four features: (1) Permission Defaults - member role now has view:resources, resources.book, resources.book_with_approval by default. Moderator has additional resources.approve, resources.view_all_bookings, resources.cancel_any, resources.process_catering. (2) ResourcesPage Cleanup - Verwaltung-Button (data-testid='resources-to-admin-btn') and tab-floorplan removed. (3) Lageplan Integration - Each type tab (rooms/desks/vehicles) has Liste/Lageplan toggle (data-testid='subview-toggle-{type}', 'subview-list-{type}', 'subview-floorplan-{type}'). FloorPlanView uses new /api/floorplans/{id}/items?type={type} endpoint. (4) InOfficeWidget Chat Integration - Avatar click opens PersonActionDialog (data-testid='in-office-action-dialog') with DM button (data-testid='in-office-action-dm') and Book button (data-testid='in-office-action-book'). DM creates/opens conversation via POST /api/chat/conversations and navigates to /chat?conv=... Book navigates to /resources?tab=desks.
